in_process.registration: AddLatticeAppsApi registers the app-control, catalogue, workspace and role-binding facades; AddLatticeAppBridgeApi adds the bridge facade.

grpc.marshalling: LatticeAppsGrpcMarshallers.Create uses Orleans Serializer<T> for gRPC payloads and clears pooled buffers after deserializing multi-segment payloads.

metadata.name: active-tenant
metadata.purpose: Configured active tenant assertion header; it is stamped for the facade and validated downstream, never trusted by the binding.

metadata.name: authorization
metadata.purpose: Credential token header; the default bridge strips the configured scheme and stamps a LatticeCredential for the facade's independent access gate.

auth.decision: RequireAuthorization defaults to true; GetAuthScheme is exempt, app-control, catalogue, workspace and bridge methods are classified by service, method and request type, unknown or mismatched operations deny by default, and the facades still enforce their independent access gates.

requires.name: AddLatticeApps
requires.reason: The app facades compose the apps engine registry, source seam and activation pipeline and fail fast if AddLatticeApps was not called first.

retry.policy: No operation id is carried; after an ambiguous failure, read the key before retrying if the caller must distinguish an original delete from an already-absent key.

idempotency.basis: The first successful delete can remove a live value and return true, while a repeat after the tombstone can return false without replaying the original response.

retry.policy: No operation id is carried and each accepted SetAsync reaches the ordinary point-write path after bridge authorization.

idempotency.basis: The facade carries no operation id and each accepted point set can author a fresh LWW write even when the bytes match a previous call.

concurrency.rule: The bridge admits write only when the consented bridge grant and the caller's app-owned role grant both cover LatticeOperation.Write for the key, then calls the gated ILattice.SetAsync path under the caller's active tenant.

retry.policy: After an ambiguous failure, read Describe or List before retrying so a completed disable is not mistaken for a fresh failure.

idempotency.basis: Disabling an already disabled app is an idempotent no-op; disabling any other non-enabled live state is rejected.

concurrency.rule: Activation runs for one tenant's app are serialized cluster-wide, and the facade authorizes AppInstall before invoking the pipeline.

retry.policy: After an ambiguous failure, read Describe or List before retrying; activation failures are recorded as state evidence rather than returned as lifecycle results.

idempotency.basis: Enabling an already enabled app is an idempotent no-op; activation excess or invalid manifests throw rather than returning a failed lifecycle result.

concurrency.rule: Activation validates the manifest against the version-pinned ceiling and serializes runs for one tenant's app before provisioning trees and replacing owned rules.

retry.policy: Unauthenticated read of configured public auth-scheme descriptors.

idempotency.basis: Returns the configured advertised auth schemes and has no side effects.

concurrency.rule: The auth interceptor exempts GetAuthScheme so clients can discover how to sign in before holding a credential.

retry.policy: Read-only consent inspection; absent or uninstalled apps return null through the response wrapper.

idempotency.basis: Reads the installed record and maps its pinned ceiling without mutation.

The same version is already live, the source result is unusable, ExpectedManifestDigest no longer matches the manifest resolved at commit, a registry transition is rejected, or re-applying an enabled upgrade fails.

retry.policy: After an ambiguous failure, inspect List, Describe, and GetConsent before retrying; installing the same version again is refused and consent changes must use UpdateConsent.

idempotency.basis: A live install at the same version is rejected; a live install at a different version upgrades in place and re-applies an enabled app.

concurrency.rule: For upgrades, the facade reads the current record and passes ExpectedVersion so a racing upgrade is refused rather than silently overwritten; authorization happens before source or registry mutation. When ExpectedManifestDigest is set, the facade re-resolves the manifest at commit and refuses a digest mismatch before recording the install.

retry.policy: Read-only tenant-scoped catalogue; includes uninstalled records and performs no mutation.

idempotency.basis: Enumerates the caller tenant's registry records and activation status evidence without mutation.

concurrency.rule: A defensive tenant equality check suppresses records outside the caller tenant even though the scan prefix is tenant-exact; responses expose no composed physical ids.

The gRPC transport authorizer denies the call, the facade AppInstall access-gate check fails, or active-tenant resolution is denied.

The activation pipeline reports a failed uninstall.

retry.policy: After an ambiguous failure, read Describe or List before retrying; an uninstalled record makes a repeat uninstall a no-op but an app with no record is NotFound.

idempotency.basis: Uninstalling an already uninstalled record is an idempotent no-op; uninstall withdraws the app rules, soft-deletes structural trees, never touches adopted trees but releases their ownership claims, and never purges data itself; the core purges each soft-deleted structural tree once its soft-delete window elapses unless it is recovered first.

concurrency.rule: The activation pipeline withdraws owned rules and soft-deletes only structural app trees; adopted trees and physical purge are outside uninstall.

The request version does not match the installed version, the registry rejects the same-version upgrade, or re-applying an enabled app fails after recording consent.

retry.policy: After an ambiguous failure, read GetConsent and Describe before retrying; an enabled app may already have had the new consent recorded before re-application failed.

idempotency.basis: A same-version replacement writes the whole ceiling; re-sending the same request converges, but any version mismatch or racing upgrade is refused.

concurrency.rule: The facade reads the installed version and revision and passes ExpectedVersion and ExpectedRevision to the same-version registry upgrade so a racing upgrade or role re-binding is refused rather than rolled back; an enabled app is reconciled after the write.

The request version does not match the installed version, the current consent is not pinned to the installed version, the same-version registry upgrade is rejected, or re-applying an enabled app fails after recording the bindings.
The gRPC service has no ILatticeAppRoleBindings implementation to invoke.

retry.policy: After an ambiguous failure, read Describe or GetConsent before retrying; an enabled app may already have had the new bindings recorded before re-application failed.

idempotency.basis: A same-version replacement writes the whole role-binding set and converges when repeated against the same revision, but a racing install change is refused by ExpectedRevision.

concurrency.rule: The facade reads the installed version and revision, validates roles against the installed manifest, passes ExpectedVersion and ExpectedRevision to the registry, and re-applies enabled apps after the write.
